description: This file contains performance monitoring and profiling utilities for the LiteLLM proxy server, including functions for sampling, starting/stopping profiling, and a decorator for profiling endpoint functions.

methods.name: _should_sample
methods.description: Determines if the current request should be sampled based on the sampling rate.

methods.name: _start_profiling
methods.description: Starts cProfile profiling globally if not already started.

methods.name: _start_profiling_for_request
methods.description: Starts profiling for a specific request if sampling criteria are met.

methods.name: _save_stats
methods.description: Saves current profiling stats to a specified file.

methods.name: profile_endpoint
methods.description: Decorator to profile endpoint functions with configurable sampling rate, supporting both sync and async functions.
